steps.title: Habituate Mice
steps.instruction: Habituate mice in their home cage within the testing room for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Suspend Mouse by Tail
steps.instruction: Grasp the mouse's tail between the base and the middle section and lift the animal clear of all surrounding objects.

steps.title: Observe Limb Position
steps.instruction: Observe the fore/hindlimb position for 00:00:10, allowing 5-10 s of resting time between observations. If the animal curls up and holds its tail/fingers, continue recording until 10s of the animal is in the correct position.

steps.title: Score Limb Clasping
steps.instruction: Assign a score based on the limb position during suspension:

substeps.instruction: Score 0: Limbs are consistently splayed outward, away from the abdomen.
Score 1: One limb is retracted toward the abdomen for more than 50% of the time suspended.
Score 2: Both limbs are partially retracted toward the abdomen for more than 50% of the time suspended.
Score 3: Limbs are entirely retracted and touching the abdomen for more than 50% of the time suspended and with curled toes.
Score 4: Both the front and hind limbs are retracted for more than 50% of the time suspended.

steps.title: Return Mouse and Record Data
steps.instruction: Place the mouse back into its cage and record the limb clasping score.

substeps.instruction: Perform this test two days per week with two trials per session.
